# Drinkee

> What should I drink? Drinkee suggests cocktails from the ingredients behind your bar, or from the weather, your mood, and how strong you want it.

Live: https://drinkee.vayuputra.co/

## Features

- Cocktail ideas ranked by how many of your ingredients they use
- Surprise me: five drinks built around one or two ingredients
- Mix me something: recommendations by season, live local weather, flavor, mood, and strength
- Estimated alcohol strength for each drink
- Recipes from TheCocktailDB

## Useful for

- Picking a cocktail to make with the bottles you have
- Finding a drink that suits the weather or the occasion
- Discovering new cocktails around a favorite spirit

## About

- Free, no sign-up, nothing to install; runs entirely in your browser.
- Made by [Suraj Malpani](https://surajmalpani.github.io/), published by [Vayuputra](https://vayuputra.co/), which lists all its free tools.
